claims.text: The $4.00 fee cannot be sustained under POL-NS-01, because limb (d) fails on the face of the trip record. The trip was terminated by the DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and limb (d) recognises only RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. POL-NS-01's own rule says DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d); such a trip is decided under POL-NS-03. One failed limb is enough - the clause is conjunctive.

Limb (b) also fails. The GPS trace's own summary places the driver's closest approach to the Blk 118 pin, across all 92 fixes, at 259.94 m, and the derived arrival block records zero qualifying in-radius fixes. POL-NS-02 deems the driver to have ARRIVED only where the trace contains at least 3 consecutive fixes of 25 m accuracy or better inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. No such fix exists anywhere in this trip, so there is no admissible arrival, limb (b) fails, and POL-NS-02 returns the fee in full.

Limb (c) fails independently of the others. The minimum dwell for a STANDARD pickup is 300 seconds; the measured in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds, a shortfall of 300 seconds measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages - the waiting period is the consideration the fee buys.

The driver cannot rescue the fee through POL-NS-06(i). Accumulating separate in-geofence intervals requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated, whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose window covers the waiting period. EV-ADVIS-00205-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 - no advisory covers Rivervale Drive in this window - so the limb is unavailable. In any event the derived arrival block records 0 in-geofence intervals, so there is no second interval to sum and no shortfall to excuse.

On the POL-NS-03 route the rider's entitlement is the same. The driver's closest approach of 259.94 m places his stationary hold outside the 50 m arrival radius but inside the 400 m ceiling, and the trace records stationary fixes at 0.0 kph. POL-NS-03 provides that on those facts the driver did not arrive, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full. The refund therefore does not depend on which of the two routes the Judge prefers; the only live question POL-NS-03 adds is who absorbs the cost, not whether the rider is repaid.

POL-NS-03(i) then leaves the driver bearing the loss and entitled to no compensation at all. The rider named the correct block - 'blk 118' - in the chat at 07:22:10, and trip_record's pickup label is 'Blk 118 Rivervale Dr, Sengkang'; the driver answered 'ok coming' at 07:22:48 and read it at 07:23:02, yet never moved to that block before cancelling at 07:33:05. DISCLOSURE: EV-CHAT-00205 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.8 with issue code CONTENT_REDACTED. The impairment is minor and does not touch this finding - the redaction removed only the unit number, and the block identifier that limb (i) turns on survives verbatim, so the finding survives the discount.

The driver's pin-ambiguity answer is unavailable on the record twice over. POL-NS-03(ii) requires trip_record.registered_pickup_points of 2 or more, and this trip registers exactly 1. And POL-NS-03 forbids any assertion that a coordinate is a particular venue, block or entrance except on a venue_id or on a party statement in the chat log; the driver's claim that 'the pin in my app showed the carpark side' rests on no venue_id comparison and no chat statement, so it establishes nothing.

The rider was at the registered pickup point for the whole wait, which contradicts the counterparty's 'nobody came' account. The rider's own track carries 96 fixes, all 96 qualifying, stationary at 0.0 kph, between 5.72 m and 22.79 m from the pin - comfortably inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m that POL-NS-04 limb (c) sets. The rider does not rest the refund on POL-NS-04, because limb (b) is not met here: the driver did reply within 120 seconds. The presence limbs (a) and (c) are nonetheless satisfied on admissible fixes and stand as evidence that the failure was the driver's, not the rider's.

There is no ground to escalate and no cap on confidence. The deciding facts - no in-radius arrival and no in-geofence dwell - are carried by EV-GPS-00205 and EV-TRIP-00205, both at weight 1.0, so under POL-GEN-02(2) the cap is the maximum of those, 1.0. The chat's schema-level IMPAIRED tag (0.8, CONTENT_REDACTED) does not meet any limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08: there is no clock skew, the trace has 100% coverage with no gaps, the chat shows no sequence gap and no hole across the arrival marker, and the $4.00 line reconciles with STANDARD + RYDE_X. It is down-weighted under POL-GEN-02 only and can neither force a PARTIAL_REFUND nor drag the ruling below the 0.70 floor.

No POL-NS-09 trigger applies, so this case should be decided rather than parked. Both disputes_with_counterparty_90d figures are 0, so trigger (c) cannot fire; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the threshold of 3 in trigger (d); and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming test is not met, since no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2/104 is 0.019 (below 0.08). No two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival or dwell. The case is clean enough for a monetary ruling.

The remedy is the whole contested amount. The cancellation-fee line is $4.00, charged on 2026-07-27 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and it matches the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect to split. POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06 each license FULL_REFUND on these facts, which under POL-GEN-03 means the filing party is entirely right and the whole contested amount is returned. The rider asks for $4.00 back and no driver compensation.

claims.text: This dispute belongs to POL-NS-03, not to a 'driver never came to the venue' reading of the file. The nearest the driver's track ever comes to the Blk 118 pin is 259.94 m, inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, and the trip record shows him marking arrival at 07:26:40 and holding for a further 6.4 minutes (wait_time_min 6.4) before he ended the trip at 07:33:05. POL-NS-02's 50 m arrival test fails on the same bundle — the derived arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-radius driver fixes — and POL-NS-02 itself yields to POL-NS-03 where the driver was stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin.

The arrival marker at 07:26:40 is not a false marker under POL-NS-05. The distance limb asks where the driver was at that marker, and the nearest his track ever comes to the pin is 259.94 m, inside the clause's 300 m leash, with nothing in the bundle placing him beyond 300 m at that timestamp. The speed limb is equally unestablished: the trace reports distinct driver speeds of 0.0 and 38.4 km/h across the whole trip but reports no speed at the marker, so no in-motion fix is matched to it. No POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral should be entered against the driver.

The zero in the derived arrival block is a zero of proximity, not of attendance. The driver's arrival marker falls at 07:26:40 and the cancellation at 07:33:05 — 384 seconds, longer than the 300 second minimum this STANDARD zone class requires — so he held out past the waiting period the fee is meant to buy. The block's 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and 0.0 s of in-geofence dwell measure the 50 m arrival radius only; the shortfall they report is a shortfall of proximity, not of waiting.

POL-NS-07 is the driver's monetary remedy in this category and nothing on his own profile blocks it. If POL-NS-01 is found satisfied, compensation is 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee — SGD 3.20 — and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile records 2 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days, below the 4-or-more count limb, against 104 completed trips in the same window, a rate of 0.019 against the greater-than-0.08 rate limb. Both limbs must hold and neither does, so the profile is not a ground for withholding compensation.

The rider's locating message was answered within the 120 second window: MSG-00205-002 ('ok coming') was sent by the driver 38 seconds after MSG-00205-001 and read 14 seconds after that, and POL-NS-04's own notes route a reply-then-mislocation case to POL-NS-03 rather than to that clause. The rider's later 'i dont see you at 118 leh' at 07:29:15 does go unanswered and I do not dispute it; the point is that the driver engaged with the locating exchange, so the mislocation between the parties is POL-NS-03's subject. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00205 is impaired — weight 0.8, issue CONTENT_REDACTED, the unit number redacted from MSG-00205-001 — so any finding drawn from the chat carries that discount under POL-GEN-02(1).

The rider's account that the driver waited 'at block 128' appears in no artifact. The chat log names block 118 and nothing else; the pickup record carries venue_id VEN-RIVERVALE-DR for Blk 118; and the bundle records no venue_id against any driver position. POL-NS-03 permits venue, block or entrance identity to rest only on a venue_id or on a party statement in the chat log, so the record cannot support a finding that the driver waited at any particular other block. EV-CHAT-00205 is impaired at weight 0.8 (CONTENT_REDACTED) and this point carries that discount.

ruling.explanation:
RIDER — the full $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to you. The no-show charge fails under the policy on three independent grounds, and any one of them is enough. (1) The trip record shows the driver terminated the trip with reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. POL-NS-01(d) recognises only RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, so the anchor clause for this fee is not satisfied. (2) The GPS trace never places the driver inside the 50 m arrival radius for a STANDARD pickup — across all 92 fixes his closest approach to the Blk 118 pin is 259.94 m, with zero qualifying in-radius fixes — so there is no admissible arrival under POL-NS-02 and limb (b) fails. (3) The in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 300-second STANDARD minimum, so POL-NS-06 makes the fee unchargeable whether or not you were present or replied. Your own track (stationary, 5.7–22.8 m from the pin) is consistent with that, but the refund does not depend on it.

DRIVER — you receive no compensation. The case is properly run under POL-NS-03, exactly as both sides argue: your nearest approach of 259.94 m is inside that clause's 400 m ceiling, so this is a wrong-location hold, not a completed arrival. But POL-NS-03's outcome on these facts is a full refund to the rider and nothing to you. The rider named the correct block ('blk 118', matching the registered pickup 'Blk 118 Rivervale Dr, Sengkang') in the chat, you answered 'ok coming' and read it, and you did not move to that block before cancelling — that is limb (i). Your pin-ambiguity answer under limb (ii) is not open: the trip registers exactly one pickup point, not two or more, and your account that the pin showed 'the carpark side' rests on no venue_id comparison and no chat statement, which POL-NS-03 does not permit. Your point that your 07:26:40–07:33:05 hold ran about 385 seconds is taken, but it was not held inside the pickup geofence; the policy measures dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and there are none.

Your POL-NS-07 compensation claim fails because POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full, which it is not, and POL-NS-03 displaces it in any event, so the 80% figure does not arise. It is not your record that bars you — 2 no-show terminations in 30 days against 104 completed trips is below both anti-farming thresholds — it is the clause. Your POL-NS-05 argument is accepted: the arrival marker is not a false marker, because the closest approach is 259.94 m (inside the 300 m test) and no in-motion fix is matched to the marker, so no false-arrival referral is recorded. The rider's passing mention of POL-NS-04 decides nothing: you replied within 120 seconds, so that clause does not apply, and the refund rests on the routes above.

ON WEIGHT AND CONFIDENCE — the chat log EV-CHAT-00205 is impaired at weight 0.8, issue code CONTENT_REDACTED (the unit number in the rider's first message was redacted). That is a schema-level impairment only: it does not meet any of the policy-level impairments in POL-NS-08(a)–(d) — the trace is unbroken with no gaps, the chat sequence is complete and matches the trip record's message count, and the $4.00 line reconciles with STANDARD + RYDE_X. Because the chat log is the artifact that carries the fault allocation under POL-NS-03, confidence is capped at 0.8 under POL-GEN-02(2); the rider's submission that the cap is 1.0 is not accepted. The block identifier the finding turns on survived the redaction, so the finding stands, and 0.8 is above the 0.70 floor. No POL-NS-09 trigger applies: the profiles show no repeat-dispute pattern and no anti-farming pattern, and no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00205-01 carries no fact and cannot be used to accumulate dwell.

ledger.claim: The $4.00 fee cannot be sustained under POL-NS-01, because limb (d) fails on the face of the trip record. The trip was terminated by the DRIVER with cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and limb (d) recognises only RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. POL-NS-01's own rule says DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d); such a trip is decided under POL-NS-03. One failed limb is enough - the clause is conjunctive.

Limb (b) also fails. The GPS trace's own summary places the driver's closest approach to the Blk 118 pin, across all 92 fixes, at 259.94 m, and the derived arrival block records zero qualifying in-radius fixes. POL-NS-02 deems the driver to have ARRIVED only where the trace contains at least 3 consecutive fixes of 25 m accuracy or better inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. No such fix exists anywhere in this trip, so there is no admissible arrival, limb (b) fails, and POL-NS-02 returns the fee in full.

Limb (c) fails independently of the others. The minimum dwell for a STANDARD pickup is 300 seconds; the measured in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds, a shortfall of 300 seconds measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages - the waiting period is the consideration the fee buys.

The driver cannot rescue the fee through POL-NS-06(i). Accumulating separate in-geofence intervals requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated, whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose window covers the waiting period. EV-ADVIS-00205-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 - no advisory covers Rivervale Drive in this window - so the limb is unavailable. In any event the derived arrival block records 0 in-geofence intervals, so there is no second interval to sum and no shortfall to excuse.

ledger.claim: There is no ground to escalate and no cap on confidence. The deciding facts - no in-radius arrival and no in-geofence dwell - are carried by EV-GPS-00205 and EV-TRIP-00205, both at weight 1.0, so under POL-GEN-02(2) the cap is the maximum of those, 1.0. The chat's schema-level IMPAIRED tag (0.8, CONTENT_REDACTED) does not meet any limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08: there is no clock skew, the trace has 100% coverage with no gaps, the chat shows no sequence gap and no hole across the arrival marker, and the $4.00 line reconciles with STANDARD + RYDE_X. It is down-weighted under POL-GEN-02 only and can neither force a PARTIAL_REFUND nor drag the ruling below the 0.70 floor.

No POL-NS-09 trigger applies, so this case should be decided rather than parked. Both disputes_with_counterparty_90d figures are 0, so trigger (c) cannot fire; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the threshold of 3 in trigger (d); and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming test is not met, since no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2/104 is 0.019 (below 0.08). No two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival or dwell. The case is clean enough for a monetary ruling.

The remedy is the whole contested amount. The cancellation-fee line is $4.00, charged on 2026-07-27 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and it matches the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect to split. POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06 each license FULL_REFUND on these facts, which under POL-GEN-03 means the filing party is entirely right and the whole contested amount is returned. The rider asks for $4.00 back and no driver compensation.

This dispute belongs to POL-NS-03, not to a 'driver never came to the venue' reading of the file. The nearest the driver's track ever comes to the Blk 118 pin is 259.94 m, inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, and the trip record shows him marking arrival at 07:26:40 and holding for a further 6.4 minutes (wait_time_min 6.4) before he ended the trip at 07:33:05. POL-NS-02's 50 m arrival test fails on the same bundle — the derived arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-radius driver fixes — and POL-NS-02 itself yields to POL-NS-03 where the driver was stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin.

The arrival marker at 07:26:40 is not a false marker under POL-NS-05. The distance limb asks where the driver was at that marker, and the nearest his track ever comes to the pin is 259.94 m, inside the clause's 300 m leash, with nothing in the bundle placing him beyond 300 m at that timestamp. The speed limb is equally unestablished: the trace reports distinct driver speeds of 0.0 and 38.4 km/h across the whole trip but reports no speed at the marker, so no in-motion fix is matched to it. No POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral should be entered against the driver.

The zero in the derived arrival block is a zero of proximity, not of attendance. The driver's arrival marker falls at 07:26:40 and the cancellation at 07:33:05 — 384 seconds, longer than the 300 second minimum this STANDARD zone class requires — so he held out past the waiting period the fee is meant to buy. The block's 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and 0.0 s of in-geofence dwell measure the 50 m arrival radius only; the shortfall they report is a shortfall of proximity, not of waiting.

POL-NS-07 is the driver's monetary remedy in this category and nothing on his own profile blocks it. If POL-NS-01 is found satisfied, compensation is 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee — SGD 3.20 — and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile records 2 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days, below the 4-or-more count limb, against 104 completed trips in the same window, a rate of 0.019 against the greater-than-0.08 rate limb. Both limbs must hold and neither does, so the profile is not a ground for withholding compensation.

The rider's locating message was answered within the 120 second window: MSG-00205-002 ('ok coming') was sent by the driver 38 seconds after MSG-00205-001 and read 14 seconds after that, and POL-NS-04's own notes route a reply-then-mislocation case to POL-NS-03 rather than to that clause. The rider's later 'i dont see you at 118 leh' at 07:29:15 does go unanswered and I do not dispute it; the point is that the driver engaged with the locating exchange, so the mislocation between the parties is POL-NS-03's subject. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00205 is impaired — weight 0.8, issue CONTENT_REDACTED, the unit number redacted from MSG-00205-001 — so any finding drawn from the chat carries that discount under POL-GEN-02(1).

The rider's account that the driver waited 'at block 128' appears in no artifact. The chat log names block 118 and nothing else; the pickup record carries venue_id VEN-RIVERVALE-DR for Blk 118; and the bundle records no venue_id against any driver position. POL-NS-03 permits venue, block or entrance identity to rest only on a venue_id or on a party statement in the chat log, so the record cannot support a finding that the driver waited at any particular other block. EV-CHAT-00205 is impaired at weight 0.8 (CONTENT_REDACTED) and this point carries that discount.
